run_find_duplicates: run the script to find duplicate documents in a JSONL corpus using MinHash LSH
create_shingles: create character n-gram shingles from a text string for similarity comparison
compute_jaccard_similarity: compute the Jaccard similarity score between two sets of shingles
review_shingles_function: review the shingles function that generates character n-grams from input text
review_jaccard_function: review the jaccard function that calculates set intersection over union similarity
